name: mba-shuttle-match-desk
description: Badminton scoreboard for singles and doubles, with live scoring, player performance stats, service tracking, and rally outcome logging.

paragraphs: Badminton match scoreboard for singles and doubles. Choose game point 20 (the default) or 14, add player names and photos, record rally outcomes, track serving and player performance, switch sides, and undo or reset a game. Game point 20 requires at least 21 to win; game point 14 requires at least 15. Both require a two-point lead, with the existing 30-point cap.

Challenge series: Before starting a standalone match, choose Single game (default), Best of 3 games, or Best of 5 games. A series ends when a side wins 2 or 3 games respectively. The scoreboard shows the running series score and completed game scores, with a next-game button until the series is won. Each game winner serves first in the next game. Reset game resets only the current game; Undo also updates its provisional series win. Earlier completed games stay in the series history. Save each game's result separately before continuing if it should count in the individual-game leaderboard;…

Player names must be unique across all active slots before starting a match, Challenge series, or tournament. Duplicate fields are marked and starting is blocked until corrected; capitalization and extra whitespace do not create a different player. Hidden doubles slots in singles mode and unused tournament entrants do not count.
